name: Tundrid Hills
summary: In south-central Dun Morogh, the Tundrid Hills offer a perilous crossing west of Gol'Bolar Quarry. Snowbound ridges and dangerous wildlife make every step off the rocky passes a risk.

sections.title: A Treacherous Wilderness
sections.body: From Coldridge Valley, the Tundrid Hills give you a rough way into eastern Dun Morogh, away from the main roads through Kharanos. Jagged slopes hold the snow, and the crossing is dangerous. Ferocious predators prowl the hills, so keep a weapon ready if you leave the beaten path.

faq.q: Where are the Tundrid Hills located?
faq.answer: The Tundrid Hills cross south-central Dun Morogh, west of Gol'Bolar Quarry. They rise south of the main road from Kharanos to the eastern lands.

faq.q: Why would anyone travel through the Tundrid Hills?
faq.answer: You can cross overland from Coldridge Valley to eastern Dun Morogh through the Tundrid Hills. The route bypasses established settlement routes, but is far more hazardous than the patrolled roads.

faq.q: What threats can be found in the Tundrid Hills?
faq.answer: Fierce wildlife adapted to the freezing heights lives in the Tundrid Hills. Few travelers venture there without a weapon at hand.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Ironforge, you know these heights remind you how wilderness and hostile Frostmane trolls press close to Dun Morogh's heartland.
As a hunter, you can track hardy beasts adapted to Dun Morogh's punishing mountain chill across these wind-battered crags.
